title: Architect
description:
Hiring: Architect – Interior Design

**Company:** Atlas Kitchen & Interiors  
**Location:** Trivandrum, Kerala  
**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Department:** Design

Job Description

Atlas Kitchen & Interiors is looking for a creative, skilled, and detail-oriented Architect to join our interior design team. The candidate will be responsible for planning, designing, and developing residential interior projects, preparing technical drawings, coordinating with clients and internal teams, and ensuring design concepts are translated into practical, high-quality execution.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop creative and functional interior design concepts for residential projects.
* Prepare space planning, layouts, furniture arrangements, and interior design proposals.
* Create 2D drawings, detailed working drawings, elevations, sections, and interior construction drawings.
* Prepare 3D models, renders, and visual presentations for clients.
* Coordinate with clients to understand their requirements, preferences, budgets, and expectations.
* Conduct site visits, measurements, and site assessments wherever required.
* Coordinate with kitchen designers, interior designers, production, execution, and installation teams.
* Select materials, finishes, colours, furniture, lighting, and other interior elements.
* Ensure designs are practical, technically accurate, and suitable for execution.
* Prepare and revise drawings based on client feedback and site conditions.
* Coordinate with factory and execution teams to ensure design accuracy during production and installation.
* Identify site issues and provide appropriate design solutions.
* Ensure projects are completed according to approved designs, specifications, and timelines.
* Stay updated with the latest interior design trends, materials, technologies, and innovations.

Requirements & Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in Architecture (B.Arch) or equivalent qualification.
* Experience in residential interior design or architectural design is preferred.
* Proficiency in AutoCAD and SketchUp.
* Knowledge of 3D rendering software such as 3ds Max, V-Ray, Lumion, Enscape, or similar.
* Knowledge of interior detailing, materials, furniture design, and space planning.
* Strong creativity, design sense, and attention to detail.
* Good communication, presentation, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Ability to work collaboratively with design, production, and execution teams.

Preferred Candidate

A creative and technically strong architect with a passion for residential interiors, innovative design, practical execution, teamwork, and continuous learning.

**Join Atlas Kitchen & Interiors and be part of a growing team delivering beautiful, functional, and high-quality interior spaces.**

Pay: From ₹30,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person
